script: [serious] In 1973, the director of the CIA gave an order: destroy the files. All of them. The program was called MKUltra. For twenty years, the agency had been testing mind-control techniques on people... many of whom never agreed to it. LSD, slipped into drinks. Sensory deprivation. Hypnosis. Electroshock. More than eighty institutions were involved: universities, hospitals, prisons. In San Francisco, the CIA ran safe houses where men were drugged and watched through one-way mirrors. It was called Operation Midnight Climax. One Army scientist, Frank Olson, was secretly dosed in 1953. Nine days later, he fell to his death from a New York hotel window. But here's the thing about destroying files. [whispers] You might miss some. In 1977, a records request turned up about twenty thousand documents that had been stored somewhere else. And the cover-up became a Senate hearing. This is Dossier Decoded. Case file number five. Which file should we open next?
